title: India is kicking car safety into top gear with Bharat NCAP 2.0: What you need to know
content: Bharat NCAP is set to evolve with its second phase, Bharat NCAP 2.0, planned for October 2027. This revised framework will assess vehicle safety across multiple stages, including crash avoidance and post-collision care. The new system promises to go beyond just occupant protection to include vulnerable road users as well. Adult and child occupant protection will remain critical components of the evaluation process.

title: UP polls: Why Akhilesh’s ‘rath’ show in Raebareli is message for Rahul
content: The Samajwadi Party's election campaign in Uttar Pradesh has been launched by Akhilesh Yadav, amid escalating conflicts with Congress over seat-sharing negotiations. Each party is eager to highlight their recent electoral achievements in their pursuit of power. Given the historical missteps that led to failed alliances, there are worries about potential pitfalls. To counter the BJP's significant influence, collaboration between both parties is crucial.

title: Zuckerberg’s $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out
content: Mark Zuckerberg's impressive superyacht, Launchpad, has recently anchored in Japan, right beside Yusaku Maezawa's Nausicaä. Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy.

title: Hardik Pandya set to miss India A fixtures; racing against time for New Zealand tour
content: The 32-year-old was inching closer to a return to cricket but the recurring shin issue has derailed all the progress he made at the BCCI Centre of Excellence in the last few months. I

title: Nebraska couple lost $59,759 home over $588 tax debt; compensation claim revived
content: A Nebraska couple, Kevin Fair and Terry Fair, lost their home due to unpaid property taxes totaling $588. After being unable to pay the amount required to redeem their property, Continental Resources obtained a tax deed. Fair claimed that losing property worth $59,759 for such a small tax debt constituted an unconstitutional taking. The Nebraska Supreme Court ruled Fair had a valid takings claim based on property value.

title: Tom Brady vs Patrick Mahomes: Why TB12 Foundation can't match 15 and Mahomies
content: Tom Brady’s TB12 Foundation was focused on health and wellness of underserved athletes and service members. Patrick Mahomes’ 15 and the Mahomies is focused on children, communities in need of resources and other charitable causes. Mahomes’ foundation is more popular than Brady’s because he has a broader scope with youth initiatives.

title: Why Trump's F-35 deal with Saudi Arabia unsettles Israel, opens big door for China
content: Under the deal, the state department has notified Congress of a possible sale of 48 jets, with engines and support, which would make Saudi Arabia the second country in the Middle East to fly the aircraft after Israel. The Saudi jets will reportedly not have all the advanced features of the F-35s operated by Israel.

title: Trump-Xi bonhomie set to continue, leaders announce two more meetings
content: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping have agreed to meet in November and December. They will hold talks in China and at the G20 summit in Miami. These meetings aim to strengthen the relationship between the two largest economies. However, their recent discussions did not result in significant breakthroughs on various issues. Xi's visit included a state dinner and cultural exchanges during China's Mid-Autumn Festival.

title: NASA sent 12.5 million tomato seeds to space; later planted across 40,000 schools
content: In 1984, NASA initiated the SEEDS project aimed at exploring how the space environment affects plant growth. Participants, comprising approximately 3.3 million students from diverse educational backgrounds worldwide, received kits that included seeds launched into space and Earth-based controls for comparison. Preliminary findings indicated a marginally enhanced germination rate for the seeds sent to space, though notable growth differences diminished during the plants' life cycles.

title: Girl started lemonade stand with $10 goal; 7 summers later, sisters raised $55,000
content: Grace Hendrian and her sister June initiated their Lemon-Aid Stand for Good in 2019 to support charity. They aimed to raise $10 but ultimately collected $55,000 for The Salvation Army. Their project encouraged community participation, leading to 14 stands operating by 2026. The sisters received recognition for their volunteer efforts as they also contributed to local families in need. Their fundraising initiative concluded in 2026, marking its final season.

title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific ocean conservation
content: The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Alonzo Mourning’s $37.4M housing project offers seniors apartments from $322
content: After his NBA career, Alonzo Mourning founded AM Affordable Housing to address the pressing need for affordable homes in South Florida. Through collaboration with Housing Trust Group, he has spearheaded various projects, including the Astoria on 9th, which boasts 120 affordable apartments in Bradenton. With overwhelming demand and countless applicants vying for limited options, Mourning draws on his foster care history to fuel his philanthropic mission.

title: Austin Rivers net worth 2026: Career earnings, salary, broadcasting and family
content: Austin Rivers had a successful 11-year career in the NBA, beginning with the New Orleans Hornets in 2012. He played for several teams and earned approximately $70 million during his playing career. Rivers retired in 2023 and transitioned to broadcasting, becoming an NBA studio analyst for ESPN and NBC Sports. He also launched his podcast, "Off Guard with Austin Rivers," to share insights from his experience.

title: India impress against Panama in 1-1 draw; Blue Tigers stand firm against WC side
content: India held FIFA World Cup side Panama to a 1-1 draw in Bengaluru after Ryan Williams gave the Blue Tigers a first-half lead. Omar Valencia equalised after the break, but India created chances to win and withstood late pressure. The result offers Khalid Jamil’s side encouragement ahead of tougher friendlies against Brazil and Uruguay in October.

title: Pakistan goes bananas over giant gorillas dancing to Bollywood songs
content: In Lahore, a vibrant new trend has emerged where massive gorillas are stealing the spotlight at weddings and celebrations. The concept, launched by Shayen Zahoor after receiving a gorilla costume in April, quickly captured attention on Instagram, amassing over a million views in just two days. This phenomenon led to a surge in event bookings, making these giant gorillas a delightful and unmistakable presence at gatherings across Pakistan.

title: San Antonio oyster shells recycled to rebuild Gulf reefs and marine habitat
content: Discarded oyster shells from San Antonio restaurants and events are being recycled to restore oyster reefs in the Gulf of Mexico. The South Texas Coastal Initiative sends collected shells to the Sink Your Shucks program, where they are reused for reef restoration. With about 100,000 oysters consumed during Fiesta Oyster Bake weekend, organizers are seeking $150,000 annually.

title: CBSE names Mandeep K Bhandari as new chairman, appointment follows OSM controversy
content: The Central Board of Secondary Education has appointed 2001-batch IAS officer Mandeep K Bhandari as its new chairman. His appointment comes months after the board faced scrutiny over the implementation of its On-Screen Marking system for Class 12 evaluation. Bhandari brings extensive administrative experience from Jammu and Kashmir and the Centre as CBSE prepares for its next examination cycle.

title: Chess Olympiad R9: Gukesh channels his world champion self to keep India in gold hunt
content: D Gukesh produced a crucial comeback win over Germany’s Alexander Donchenko in Round 9, helping India stay in the Chess Olympiad gold medal race. India’s men beat Germany 2.5-1.5, while Vantika Agrawal and Divya Deshmukh powered the women’s team to victory. India’s men trail Uzbekistan, while the women remain second behind leaders China with two rounds left.

title: Mumbai prime home prices rise 6.2%, enter global top 10
content: In a striking development, Mumbai has surged into the world’s top 10 residential markets, landing at eighth place with a notable 6.2% annual price gain. Bengaluru and New Delhi aren't far behind, securing the 12th and 17th spots. While global prices ticked up by only 2.6%, Mumbai's luxury segment stands resilient, fueled by high demand and limited housing options in prime locales.

title: Who is Tommy “Gun” McMillen? Meet UFC’s 12-0 featherweight prospect
content: Tommy 'Gun' McMillen is building his reputation in the UFC featherweight division with an undefeated record. He began his combat sports journey at a young age, excelling in wrestling and boxing. McMillen has won all three of his UFC fights, showcasing his striking and finishing abilities. He broke a UFC record for significant strikes landed in a three-round fight during his bout with Alberto Montes.

title: Called ‘black-complexioned’ and ‘fatty-shaped’: Why man’s divorce plea failed
content: A husband in Chhattisgarh appealed for divorce from his wife due to claims of cruelty and desertion. The high court examined the evidence and found the husband's allegations lacked proof. The court noted that inappropriate comments alone did not justify granting a divorce. Additionally, the wife provided counterclaims against her husband’s behavior and care. Consequently, the court upheld the family court's decision and dismissed the divorce appeal.

title: Haaland's Man City face expulsion threat: Club found guilty on 114 financial charges

title: Trump gives 'totally unacceptable' warning to Xi over China helping Iran

The two leaders held a closed-door meeting to discuss various critical global issues, including trade and military matters. Trump organized a state dinner attended by key US technology executives to enhance relations. The visit coincided with China's Mid-Autumn Festival, marking a time for family gatherings and festivities.

title: 'Glaciers, floods don't travel with visas': Nepal PM's India-China appeal

title: Massive fire at Delhi building housing Haldiram’s outlet; 30 rescued

After a swift police response, around 30 people were safely evacuated from the premises. The Delhi fire service deployed 23 units to control the medium fire, which started due to a suspected short circuit.

title: Asian Games: India win six medals, including shooting gold, as Baranica makes history

In shooting, Suruchi Singh and Kamaljeet delivered a sensational performance, earning gold and ending a lengthy wait for that accolade.

title: The Backstory: When 'Tau' Devi Lal won the PM race, and then gave it away
